Brand Overview

Mission Statement

To bridge the gap between creative vision and business impact through strategic design thinking, data-driven insights, and innovative digital experiences that resonate with audiences and drive measurable results.

Core Values

  • • Innovation: Pushing creative boundaries while maintaining strategic focus
  • • Impact: Delivering measurable business results through design
  • • Authenticity: Genuine storytelling that connects with audiences
  • • Excellence: Commitment to quality in every detail

Brand Personality

Strategic

Data-driven approach with clear business objectives

Creative

Innovative solutions that stand out in the market

Collaborative

Building strong partnerships and team dynamics

Results-Oriented

Focus on measurable outcomes and business impact

Brand Manifesto

Where Art Meets ROI

I believe creativity isn't just beautiful - it's profitable. Every campaign I craft, every story I tell, every visual I design serves a dual purpose: to inspire and to deliver measurable business results. From my roots in Venezuela to my life in Seattle, I've learned that the most powerful marketing happens when artistic vision meets strategic thinking.

Creative Excellence

Award-winning campaigns that break through the noise and create emotional connections

Strategic Impact

Data-driven decisions that turn creative investments into measurable business growth

Cultural Intelligence

Global perspective that resonates across markets while staying authentic to brand values

Voice & Messaging

Brand Voice

  • Confident: Speaks with authority backed by experience
  • Strategic: Every message serves a business purpose
  • Authentic: Genuine, personal, and relatable
  • Results-Focused: Emphasizes outcomes and impact
  • Culturally Aware: Globally minded with local relevance

Tone Guidelines

  • Professional yet approachable - Expert without being intimidating
  • Data-driven storytelling - Facts wrapped in compelling narratives
  • Solution-oriented - Focus on possibilities and outcomes
  • Inclusive language - Welcoming to diverse audiences
  • Action-inspiring - Motivates next steps and engagement

Key Messages

Primary Message

"Where creativity meets ROI; transforming artistic vision into measurable business impact through strategic marketing and design."

Supporting Message

"From Venezuela to Seattle, bringing global perspective and cultural intelligence to every campaign, story, and visual experience."

Call to Action

"Ready to turn your creative vision into business results? Let's create something extraordinary together."

Usage Guidelines

Brand Do's

  • ✓ Use the primary logo on light backgrounds for maximum impact
  • ✓ Maintain consistent spacing and proportions across all applications
  • ✓ Use coral color strategically for CTAs and key highlights
  • ✓ Ensure sufficient contrast for accessibility compliance
  • ✓ Test all applications across different devices and contexts

Brand Don'ts

  • ✗ Don't stretch, skew, or distort any logo elements
  • ✗ Don't use unauthorized color combinations or gradients
  • ✗ Don't place logos on busy backgrounds without proper contrast
  • ✗ Don't use outdated logo versions or create new variations
  • ✗ Don't overcrowd layouts or ignore white space principles

Color Palette

#121212

Deep Black

Primary text, backgrounds, sophisticated contrast

#F96F6E

Coral Red

Accent, CTAs, highlights, energy

#B2B2BB

Cool Gray

Secondary text, borders, subtle elements

#2C3E50

Deep Blue

Backgrounds, subtle accents, depth

Color Applications

Primary Combinations
  • • Deep Black + Coral Red (high impact)
  • • Deep Blue + Cool Gray (professional)
  • • White + Coral Red (clean energy)
  • • Deep Black + Cool Gray (sophisticated)
Usage Guidelines
  • • Use coral sparingly for maximum impact
  • • Deep black for authority and sophistication
  • • Cool gray for supporting information
  • • Deep blue for subtle depth and variation

Typography System

Big Shoulders Display

Bold, impactful headlines that command attention. Used for all primary headings, hero text, and statement pieces.

H1 Heading - 48px Bold
H2 Heading - 36px Bold
H3 Heading - 28px Bold
H4 Heading - 24px Bold

Inter

Clean, web-readable text that ensures excellent readability across all devices and contexts. Primary body font with extensive weight options.

Bold Body Text - 20px Bold
Semibold Text - 18px Semibold
Regular Body Text - 16px Regular
Supporting Text - 14px Regular
Caption Text - 12px Regular

Dancing Script

Signature style for personal touches, quotes, and humanizing elements. Use sparingly for maximum impact.
